traceability.notes: All functional requirements and acceptance criteria for Story 009.0-DEV-MAINTENANCE-TOOLS are implemented and verified. The codebase provides: - A complete maintenance API (detect/update/batch/verify/report) exported via the plugin. - A documented and tested CLI (`traceability-maint`) with detect, verify, report, and update subcommands, clear messages, JSON modes, dry-run behavior, and robust error handling. - Tests that cover correctness, edge cases (missing roots, permission errors, unsafe paths), and performance on large workspaces. - User-facing documentation describing both the programmatic API and the CLI with concrete usage examples and behavior details. Given the breadth of implementation, traceability annotations, passing tests, and aligned documentation, the story is fully satisfied.
